meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 当用户要海报、画作或静态设计时,Claude 先写下设计哲学(.md),再把它画成一张 .pdf 或 .png 作品。作品保持原创、不仿照已有艺术家,文字极少,靠图形与色彩表达。
howto.when: 当用户要求做海报、艺术画、设计等静态视觉作品时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一张极简风格的音乐会海报。
say.note: Claude 会先写设计哲学,再产出海报图片。

say.text: 画一幅抽象艺术作品,主题是‘城市孤独’。
say.note: 它会生成原创视觉,而非复制现有画作。

say.text: 设计一张蓝灰色调的几何海报,用于展览。
say.note: 它会先给出设计哲学,再画出成品。

howto.what_en: For poster/art/design requests, Claude writes a design philosophy (.md), then renders an original, non-copied .pdf or .png, using minimal text and visual-first composition.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static visual piece.

say_en.text: Make a minimalist poster for a concert.
say_en.note: Claude starts with a philosophy, then outputs the poster.

say_en.text: Create an abstract artwork themed on urban loneliness.
say_en.note: It produces an original visual, not a copy.

say_en.text: Design a blue-gray geometric poster for an exhibition.
say_en.note: It will first give a philosophy, then render the final image.
